idris.name: lcrs_6_2__corr_is
idris.note: A read correlation is the sweep's under LSTR.3.1's codepoint equality; a fact that reads none never matches.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2__empty_corr_sweeps_nothing
idris.note: THE EMPTY CORRELATION SWEEPS NOTHING on either side: a transcription of the victims' empty clause, said so. THE EMPTY CORRELATION IS EXEMPT from the arrival's sweep, as the clause has it: an answer whose `corr` is the empty String supersedes nothing, and the consequence holds for each non-empty correlation.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2__is_victim
idris.note: A victim of a sweep: a fact of one of the swept kinds whose correlation is the sweep's.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2__no_carrier_sweeps_nothing
idris.note: A correlation no live fact carries sweeps nothing: the sweep is the identity, over every state.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2__sweep_ids_net
idris.note: The sweep on the clocked network: the ids retracted one at a time through alpha dispatch, then the cascade; nothing to sweep is the identity.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2__sweep_ids_net_sub
idris.note: A SWEEP ONLY REMOVES: a fact live after it was live before, over every id list and state.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2__swept_not_live
idris.note: WHAT A SWEEP WAS ASKED TO REMOVE IS GONE: under unique ids a fact live after a sweep carries none of its ids.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2__victims
idris.note: The ids of the live victims in working-memory order; the empty correlation has none, on the call side by LRST.1.2's rule and on the arrival side by the clause's. THE EMPTY CORRELATION IS EXEMPT from the arrival's sweep, as the clause has it: an answer whose `corr` is the empty String supersedes nothing, and the consequence holds for each non-empty correlation.
